newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM rubber falls sharply on lower spot expiry.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM rubber falls sharply on lower spot expiry.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower on Tuesday, led by steep falls in nearby months after the spot June contract expired at a sharply lower level, Japanese traders said.
The spot June contract expired at 115.0 yen per kg, down from Monday's close of 120.8 yen. Deliveries were 492 lots.
Other prices ranged from 0.4 yen to 5.2 yen per kg lower.

"Market players were reluctant to take deliveries at the expiry due to the lower quality of rubber, which caused a sharp fall in the expiry price," one trader said. "Nearby months have more room to slip amid bearish sentiment," he said.
